title: Use the NemoVideoAI × Seedance 2.0 workflow by uploading you...
content: Use the NemoVideoAI × Seedance 2.0 workflow by uploading your clips so the AI can analyze hook and pacing, then let Seedance 2.0 generate high-quality visuals featuring your IP characters and output a full edit in minutes.
description:
Just tested the @nemovideoai × Seedance 2.0 workflow and it’s honestly wild.

Uploaded the clips → the AI broke down the hook and pacing → SD2 generated high quality visuals featuring the IP characters → full edit ready in under 3 minutes.

It feels less like editing and more like activating a system that already understands how to capture and hold attention.

#NemoVideo #Seedance2
